verdict.rationale: Plaid's own docs have a dedicated webhooks API reference stating that Plaid sends webhooks to programmatically inform you about Item changes and async process status. The Transactions docs also describe staying up to date via webhooks, so this is first-party outbound HTTP callbacks rather than a chat integration. missing for 10: documented webhook URL registration/configuration, event-type catalog, signature verification and retry details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Plaid sends webhooks to programmatically inform you about changes to Plaid Items or the status of asynchronous processes.
Retrieve up to 24 months of transaction data and stay up-to-date with webhooks
